Corollary
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0057 1. Corollary 2.23\group neckpinch

The quantity $a$ remains uniformly bounded by its initial supremum: $\sup |a(\cdot ,t)|\le \sup |a(\cdot ,0)|$.
